_notes: Shape follows the unity -> audio request (docs/progress/requests.md); extra keys are informational.

sfx keys are sfx ids. Only the five marked status=in_contract exist in contract/ids/sfx.json so far; the rest are proposals for FE to add. footsteps keys = surface, ambience keys = venue ids (plus club_doors), music keys = client district ids (timeline, trenches, builder_hills, airdrop_farm, dubai_marina) plus perp_pit and clubs, babble keys = archetype ids plus default.
volume is linear (0..1) = 10^(volume_db/20). Every entry also carries its prefixed id (sfx_, foot_, amb_, mus_, babble_).
One-shot SFX and footsteps are normalised to -1 dBTP true peak (consistent peaks); mix with volume.
Ambience loops: -24 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -3 dBTP (Spaces Studio room tone -36 LUFS).
Music: each set's full mix (pad+bass+drums+lead) is -17 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -2 dBTP; all stems of a set have identical sample length. market_mood rules: audio/README.md.
Entries with full_mix use a complete licensed composition, not stems; music-curation.json owns these overrides.
Babble: files are ordered a..z (letters map); play rules in audio/BABBLE.md and audio/unity/BabblePlayer.cs.
